posts.title: Gemini 4 Carbon, Hydrogen, Decisions API, self-hosted agent sandboxes and more
posts.description: Last week we shipped 7 launches across models, agent infrastructure, benchmarks, and science: two Gemini 4 models, our first Decision Model and API, self-hosted agent sandboxes, a new visual knowledge benchmark, and new robotics and genomics models.

posts.title: Why Agents Are Soon Only Going to Have 1 Tool
posts.description: Instead of triggering tools one at a time across turns, agents are collapsing their tool catalog into a single exec(code) tool—chaining, filtering, and awaiting actions inside an isolated sandbox.

posts.title: Credentials API for Gemini Managed Agents
posts.description: Store secrets once with the Credentials API, reference them by ID, and let the egress proxy inject them on the wire so they never enter the agent sandbox.
